scope: Three additional official winning decks, distinct from earlier Waterloo2026/Lightspeed, Yale2025/Middleby and Kozminski2025/DomDevelopment examples. Read relevant actual pages and visually inspect six key exhibits. Research benchmark, no pitch edits or outreach.

examples.name: UNC Advanced Drainage Systems (WMS)
examples.specific_lesson: Page3 pairs each operating thesis with a market-perception claim and matched forecasts. Page6 decomposes FY26 margin improvement into60bp segment mix and20bp cheaper recycled input use, ending at39.8% versus39.3% consensus. Page5 connects Infiltrator demand to housing completions/roughly6month lag from starts. These remain their forecasts, not proven causal estimates.
examples.intel_gap: Our page5 is an internally consistent blend assuming Q3 CPU profitability persists; an observable price/cost/mix and competitive-economics bridge would more directly support40%. Our page3 labels a single public analyst comparison rather than establishing matched broad consensus.
examples.do_not_copy: Large terminal return assumptions, noisy visual styling or presumed consensus error solely because forecast differs.

examples.name: Columbia Janus International (JBI)
examples.specific_lesson: Pages4-5 state why pricing could be wrong: SPAC/ownership pressure and mixing renovation demand with new construction. Page8 quantifies renovation revenue content at~20USD/sqft versus~8USD greenfield. Page9 connects forecasts to consensus and three valuation scenarios; page14 distinguishes team channel checks from purchased transcripts.
examples.intel_gap: Intel identifies drivers but has little demonstrated present valuation cushion. Need an exact explanation of what current expectations understate and why evidence should resolve that difference. A road map alone is not a differentiated insight.
examples.do_not_copy: Peer multiple premiums as automatic fair value or risk mitigants as proof downside is small. Two methods sharing forecasts are not independent validations.

examples.name: University of Waterloo Cargojet (CJT)
examples.printed_page_offset: Printed page is PDF page minus1 for these exhibits.
examples.specific_lesson: PDFp28/printed27 uses flight tracking over2021-2023 to support Latin American activity growth. PDFp33/printed32 shows fleet sizes and utilization while projecting growth without new fleet expansion. Together these exhibit operational observations tied to a cash-conversion mechanism.
examples.intel_gap: Our original Oracle billing correction is useful but expressly does not establish vendor pricing power, mature DCAI margin or capital productivity. A flagship exhibit should bear more directly on the assumption producing the recommendation.
examples.do_not_copy: Its195page length includes appendix and animation-stage repeats; inappropriate for M37 tenpage screen. Neither interview count nor flight activity proves profit or investment outcome.

our_strengths: Professional readable layout and claim-oriented headings already match genre.
Cash bridge accounts explicitly for investment and working capital, with no extra multiple expansion.
Mixed-quarter counterchecks and severe immediate valuation stress are more transparent than typical boilerplate risk mitigants.
Honest provenance: no interview, matched workload experiment or market-consensus claim invented.
remaining_gaps_ranked: Evidence directly supporting durable40%DCAI margins, with2027-2030 profit/cash consequences, rather than a long-run endpoint alone.
Why current price represents enough reward for the specific risk; a~10% modeled return at near fair value is a modest investment case, not strong demonstrated mispricing.
Match forecast definitions/dates against several available independent analyst estimates or characterize price-implied expectations with model dependence explicit.
Move repeated methodological caveats into precise footnotes where possible; keep material objections visible, do not erase them.
verdict: Recognizably a legitimate competition pitch and careful research draft. Not yet demonstrated equal to these winners on differentiated, investment-decisive evidence. Main deficit is thesis substantiation and opportunity strength rather than slide cosmetics.
limits: Selected winners are not representative sample or causal evidence of winning features.
Different teams, judges, deadlines and rules; no winning probability can be inferred.
Source business claims and historical forecasts inspected as communication examples, not independently re-underwritten or endorsed.
No inference from later investment returns.
No completed interviews, workload testing, outreach or modifications to current pitch in this subtask.
